criteria.statement: StartTurn builds replay-backed model input, injects tool schemas, executes a read-only sync tool through AssistantToolRuntime, feeds the resulting AssistantToolObservation back as a role=tool message, and completes when the model stops.

An async mutation tool produces a waiting_async observation that suspends the loop without blocking; ResumeAfterAsyncObservation observes the terminal result through the runtime, appends a tool observation, and continues model iteration.

A permission ask observation suspends the loop as awaiting_approval; approving the deferred action executes the original tool through the runtime and feeds the resulting observation back to the model.
Rejecting a deferred action does not execute the tool and instead feeds a denial observation back to the model so it can continue.
Transcript replay is used as model memory across turns, and loop appends user, assistant, and tool observation messages to the transcript interface.
max_iterations and max_consecutive_tool_failures from AssistantAgenticConfig bound runaway loops by moving the session/loop to blocked.
The loop remains decoupled from internal/mcp by using service-local tool schema and runtime interfaces, exposing a clean API for item 8.
